name: Hero Carousel — automatic rotation advances motorcycles periodically
description: Verifies that the automated carousel cycle periodically rotates to the next motorcycle without user intervention.

planSteps.description: Navigate to / and observe the initially displayed motorcycle title and indicator position
Wait for 2 to 3 seconds without moving mouse or clicking any controls
The carousel automatically rotates and updates the active motorcycle name to the next model in sequence
The active indicator pill shifts to match the newly active motorcycle index
